releaseNotes:
1. Optimized the Matter pairing experience. If you first pair with Apple Home, you can directly pair with the Aqara Matter controller in Aqara without generating a pairing code through Apple Home;
2. Optimized the device indicator light. After pairing to Matter, a single press of the Set button causes the device light to flash white twice and a single beep;
3. Improved the dual-lock experience for a single door and fixed known issues;
4. Improved the guidance prompt for the door status on the home screen when it shows [Unknown status];
5. Fixed other known issues;
